archive_delivery: Conversation download. The full binary frozen-state archive is not stored as a Git blob.
git_saved: source capture snapshots and prior protocols
autonomous_account_replay: Extract the delivered archive; run python src/replay_saved_states.py --out /new/empty/path inside OLC105. All six states, 118 reference daily accounts, 10 full reference matrix paths and engine source are included. No model downloads or network needed for account replay.
upstream_regeneration: Requires original frozen models/input archives identified by SHA256 in ORIGINAL_DEPENDENCIES.json in the delivered archive, plus OLC104 source layout. The archive does not claim standalone feature/model regeneration.
